items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: I know he was playing at the ringside with Chink Martin and Joe Caprera and Shawky in those days.

ctx.x: Well what notes would you play with your left hand and what with the right? Would you just, would you play a full chord with your left hand?

No, no, no. Usually we played, in fact we could even play, we could even play, oh in fact, this point right here, I'm glad that you reminded me of a piano player, I mustn't forget Freddie. Freddie Newman. Because Freddie Newman was a very, very fine band, played great, great rhythm, because he had been playing with the remnants of the Rhythm Kings, you know. I don't know if he played with the, with the early Rhythm Kings, but I know he was playing at the ringside with Chink Martin and Joe Caprera and Shawky in…
They seem to swing sometimes, you know. Oh yeah. In a way, a single note, something simple like that would really swing.
